facts.copy:
Burns Landscaping ΓÇö Houston's Premier Lawn & Landscape Experts

Your home,

Transforming Houston homes with expert landscaping and lawn care since 1998.

NAVIGATION

CONTACT US

Burns Landscaping delivers premium lawn care and landscape design to Houston homeowners. From lush lawns to complete outdoor transformations we make it happen.

Family owned since 1998, Burns Landscaping combines decades of experience with a new generation committed to carrying that same standard of service forward. WeΓÇÖve built our reputation by doing quality work, treating people right, and building lasting relationships with our customers throughout Houston.

For us, great landscaping really is personal. We take the time to understand your property, your vision, and what you want from your outdoor space. From the first consultation to the finished project and beyond, our goal is to provide thoughtful recommendations, dependable service, and work we're proud to put our name on.

Custom landscapes designed around your home, style, and property from plant selection and layered beds to complete landscape renovations.

Dependable, professional maintenance year-round: mowing, edging, trimming, bed care, and seasonal cleanups tailored to your property.

New sprinkler system design and installation, plus repairs and adjustments to keep your landscape receiving the right amount of water.

Transforming Houston homes with expert landscaping and lawn care since 1998.

NAVIGATION

CONTACT US

Burns Landscaping has been serving Houston homeowners for nearly three decades. We built this company on quality work, trusted relationships, and the belief that great landscaping is personal.

We don't cut corners. Every project is executed with care, precision, and materials we stand behind ΓÇö because our name is on every job we do.

Landscape Design & Installation

We create custom landscapes designed around your home, style, and property. From plant selection and layered beds to complete landscape renovations, our team combines thoughtful design with plants proven to thrive in Houston.

Lawn & Landscape Maintenance

Keep your property looking its best year-round with dependable, professional maintenance. Our team provides routine lawn and landscape care tailored to the needs of your property, from mowing and edging to trimming, bed maintenance, and seasonal cleanups.

Irrigation Systems

A healthy Houston landscape starts with proper irrigation. We design and install new sprinkler systems, troubleshoot existing systems, and make repairs and adjustments to help your landscape receive the right amount of water where it needs it.

Drainage Solutions

Houston's heavy rainfall can quickly expose drainage problems. We evaluate problem areas and design practical drainage solutions that help move excess water away from your home, lawn, and landscape.

Outdoor Lighting

Extend the beauty of your landscape beyond daylight with professionally designed outdoor lighting. From subtle pathway lighting to architectural uplighting, we create systems that enhance your home, landscape, and outdoor spaces while adding visibility and security.

Outdoor Living & Hardscapes

Create an outdoor space made for living. We design and build hardscape features that complement your home and landscape, from patios and walkways to outdoor kitchens, fire features, and complete outdoor living spaces.
